name: Spanking Your Child
overview: Scripture affirms the importance of loving discipline in raising children, emphasizing that withholding correction is harmful to them while timely chastening expresses love (Proverbs 13:24). The use of the rod serves to remove foolishness and instill wisdom, as a child naturally resists rebuke but benefits from firm instruction (Proverbs 13:1; 22:15). Training a child in the right way ensures lasting faithfulness, and even physical discipline can have a purifying effect on inward attitudes (Proverbs 20:30; 22:6). These verses collectively highlight that disciplined correction, grounded in love and wisdom, is a vital part of godly parenting.
